overall_summary: Family emotional bonds, universal relationships, and gentle motivation (e.g., Maa, Papa, calling loved ones) dramatically outperform niche romantic heartbreak and overly specific smartphone-settings self-respect tropes, pulling 90 to 275+ views compared to 1-40 views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about Mother (OfHrAp3r1G8 - 215 views), Father (v8krtdmxbPs - 132 views), and checking in on loved ones (rl_ycNbXZ_g - 275 views) vastly outperformed romantic niche topics.
winning_patterns.action: Pivot focus from micro-romantic heartbreak to broad, universally relatable emotional bonds and family connections.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video rl_ycNbXZ_g ('आज किसी अपने को Call कर लेना') achieved 275 views by prompting a direct, positive emotional action.
winning_patterns.action: Include gentle life advice or calls-to-action that resonate deeply with anyone who misses someone.

weak_patterns.pattern: Hyper-niche smartphone UI actions for self-respect
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on specific UI actions like clearing cloud storage, unpinning chats, or changing default ringtones (e.g., LBGCloAitok - 4 views, hT4EGP69mRw - 3 views) had extremely low engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid granular, repetitive digital settings tropes and focus on broader emotional states.
